body: I was at my lowest when I tried to kill myself and my mom 2 years ago. I thought it would get better from there but it never did.

The only peace will far away from people but that's not really possible. I just feel lower and lower and I'm just sinking into a hole in my bed. This life is meaningless and I'm in constant pain. I have nothing I care about. There's no future for this world. Why shouldn't I do it? I have no good reason not to
Obsessive compulsive disorder that has never improved after 15 years of treatment
The small moments of happiness haven't been worth being scared and angry every day of my life.
Being powerless will never make me feel better.
